### Rivetari judge · round 1 · approve

#### Acceptance
- A1: met — The old action:build/committed dist rule is replaced. The new bullet says task PRs don't commit packages/action/dist or the copied assets (controls, gates, templates, prompts, skill), CI builds the bundle on every PR, the Version Packages PR rebuilds and commits it, and the action is pinned to a release commit.
- A2: met — The diff touches only AGENTS.md and has no changes under packages/action. The rest of AGENTS.md is unchanged.

<details><summary>1 suggestion(s), non-blocking</summary>

- Pin guidance is terse and doesn't say why `AGENTS.md:113` — Append: 'because only release commits carry a current bundle.'

</details>

suggestions.title: Pin guidance is terse and doesn't say why
suggestions.detail: 'Anyone pinning the action pins a commit from a release' is accurate to the card, but it doesn't say that non-release commits have no rebuilt dist, so a pin to one would run a stale or missing bundle. A short why clause would match the file's 'say why' comment rule.
suggestions.fix: Append: 'because only release commits carry a current bundle.'
